result.summary: Found 1 issue: duplicate restaurant cards in the Fastest near you section make the page look visually broken.

issues.description: The first two cards in the 'Fastest near you' carousel are identical: both show 'Green Bowl Poké' with the same 15-25 min badge, same bowl illustration, and same €0.90 delivery text.
issues.suggestion: Remove the duplicate entry and ensure the carousel lists distinct nearby restaurants with correct images and metadata.
